verdict.rationale: Name.com exposes a full REST-style Core API with HTTP Basic auth (API tokens for dev/prod), official typed SDKs (TypeScript, Go, PHP), and a dedicated sandbox environment explicitly for automated integration testing without side effects — all standard building blocks for headless/CI automation. Webhooks further support event-driven automation pipelines. Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD example pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions) or OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), and no independent hands-on report confirming CI use.
